ZWE.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
AI is mentioned only as a workplace trend to be tracked; no government AI use.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in Zimbabwe stated.
Nothing on civil servant digital-skills training.
The National Data Centre hosts a government platform; no renting to other organisations is stated.

facts.fact: The ICT minister, speaking at the launch, said management of the labour market information system must follow the Cyber and Data Protection Act, treating it as an applicable law.

ZWE.note: Only a remark that the system will inform training; no public digital-skills programme stated.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare

ZWE.note: The labour market portal is a statistics platform for policymakers and researchers, not a service people complete online.

facts.fact: The ICT ministry says it provided the hosting environment at the National Data Centre for the government's Zimbabwe Labour Market Information System platform and its database.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services
